name: soft_mixed_weight1.k
model:
class SoftMixed1 {
  on:Bool
  n:Int

  req n >= 0

  req n <= 10

  req on = (n > 5)

  soft req on weight 3

  soft req !on
  maximize n
}

main:SoftMixed1
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((SoftMixed1 (mk-SoftMixed1 (on Bool)(n Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-SoftMixed1 (sel-SoftMixed1 SoftMixed1))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-SoftMixed1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-SoftMixed1 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-SoftMixed1 ((this Ref)) SoftMixed1
  (sel-SoftMixed1 (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-SoftMixed1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-SoftMixed1 this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ---------------------------------
;   Getters for class SoftMixed1:
; ---------------------------------

; --- getters for SoftMixed1.on: ---

(define-fun SoftMixed1!on ((this Ref)) Bool
  (on (deref-SoftMixed1 this))
)

; --- getters for SoftMixed1.n: ---

(define-fun SoftMixed1!n ((this Ref)) Int
  (n (deref-SoftMixed1 this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-SoftMixed1 (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; -----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class SoftMixed1:
; -----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-SoftMixed1 SoftMixed1)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun SoftMixed1.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (SoftMixed1!n this) 0)
)

(assert (! (SoftMixed1.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun SoftMixed1.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (SoftMixed1!n this) 10)
)

(assert (! (SoftMixed1.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun SoftMixed1.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SoftMixed1!on this) (> (SoftMixed1!n this) 5))
)

(assert (! (SoftMixed1.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Soft Constraint 4: ---

(define-fun SoftMixed1.soft4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (SoftMixed1!on this)
)

(assert-soft (SoftMixed1.soft4 1) :weight 3 :id k_soft)

; --- Soft Constraint 5: ---

(define-fun SoftMixed1.soft5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (not (SoftMixed1!on this))
)

(assert-soft (SoftMixed1.soft5 1) :weight 1 :id k_soft)




; ================================
; === Optimization Objectives: ===
; ================================

(maximize (let ((this 1)) (SoftMixed1!n this)))

; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-SoftMixed1 const-1-SoftMixed1))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun const-1-SoftMixed1 () SoftMixed1
  (mk-SoftMixed1 true 10))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-SoftMixed1 a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (<= (n (sel-SoftMixed1 (select heap 1))) 10))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (> (n (sel-SoftMixed1 (select heap 1))) 5)))
  (= (on (sel-SoftMixed1 (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (>= (n (sel-SoftMixed1 (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-SoftMixed1 (mk-SoftMixed1 true 10))))
